scope: Logical review of three unappended IH drafts; no idea add, review, refresh, ledger, build, or experiment.
method: Compared the full draft designs with exact bounded cards IDEA000028, IDEA000030, IDEA000032, ran proposal duplicate navigation and route-check, and validated every source span with tools.semantic_identity._evidence(Path.cwd(), [source_evidence]).

corrections.reason: IDEA000028 explicitly covers required/forbidden action. The IH draft now fixes one target: negative prohibition of an otherwise stable action, excluding requirement, non-applicability, and conditionality. This is a narrower falsifier, not a new general modality claim; an independent prohibition endpoint is still missing.
corrections.countermodel: A register/template wrapper can mimic negative status without encoding prohibition.
corrections.falsifier_scope: No independently bound prohibition interaction in matched action/material contexts; downstream requirement or non-applicability is a rival outcome, not a pass.

corrections.reason: Temporal order and causal dependence are distinct target relations, but a temporal marker may correlate with a downstream consequence. The former draft incorrectly treated consequence prediction/correlation as a falsifier.
corrections.countermodel: A wrapper or field-position policy can generate earlier placement without temporal semantics.
corrections.falsifier_scope: Only failure or reversal of the independently bound candidate/order contrast after controls falsifies precedence. Consequence correlation alone does not; discrimination needs cases varying order and causal relation separately.

corrections.reason: IDEA000032 tests shared list grouping. IH now targets member-level predicate scope. Distributivity does not require heterogeneous outcomes: 'each is red' can be uniformly true.
corrections.countermodel: A renderer can repeat member fields for a collective group.
corrections.falsifier_scope: Only consistent absence of independently bound member-level predicate scope, with group-level licensing instead, falsifies; uniform outcomes or repeated fields alone do not.

dependency_limits: All three remain raw/unreviewed with availability_unknown independent meaning endpoints. GDT269 and GDT238 observations motivate contrasts but do not bind meanings. No readiness or empirical pass is claimed.
